title: CommandsPROMAX(TXHZ)
description: use this 2 make ur in-game id fancier!
body:
# 增强型指令MOD | Enhanced Commands Mod

## 简介 | Overview
这是一个用于**添加更多增强型指令**的 Minecraft MOD，旨在为生存玩家提供**更多便利性**，提升与朋友联机时的游戏体验。  
该 MOD 力求保持**平衡性**，并欢迎玩家提供反馈。  
最重要的是，它是一个**客户端 MOD**，当你不想使用服务端但仍希望联机时，它是**首选方案**。

This is a Minecraft mod designed to **add more enhanced commands** for survival players, improving convenience and delivering a **better multiplayer experience** with friends.  
It strives for **game balance** and welcomes user feedback.  
Most importantly, it’s a **client-side mod**, making it the **ideal choice** when you want to play together without setting up a server.

---

## 为什么下载 | Why Download
- 为生存玩家增加更多便利操作  
- 在不牺牲平衡性的情况下提升游戏体验  
- 无需服务端即可在多人游戏中生效  

- Adds more convenience for survival players  
- Enhances gameplay without breaking balance  
- Works in multiplayer **without a server-side installation**

---

## 使用方法 | How to Use
- **前缀 Prefix:** `/tx <text> <color> [bold]`  
- **后缀 Suffix:** `/hz <text> <color> [bold]`  
- **修改昵称 Change Nickname:** `/nick <text>` (does not affect save files)  
- **恢复原昵称 Reset Nickname:** `/scnick`  

> 所有指令仅限 OP 使用，暂时无法设置他人的前后缀（未来可能会更新）。  
> All commands are OP-only and currently cannot set prefixes or suffixes for other players (may be added in future updates).

---

## 注意事项 | Notes
- 版本支持：**1.20.* Forge**  
- 指令简单易用  
- 欢迎在评论中反馈建议或 Bug，我会查看 :))

- Supported Versions: **1.20.* Forge**  
- Beginner-friendly command structure  
- Feedback and bug reports are welcome — leave a comment and I’ll check it :))
